ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is amended
by changing all the Residential Planned Development Number 793 symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 2-J in the area bounded by:

South St. Louis Avenue; West Roosevelt Road; a line 292.5 feet west of South St.
Louis Avenue; and the alley next south of and parallel to West Grenshaw Street,

to those of a B3-3 Community Shopping District which is hereby established in the area above.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in full force and effect from and after its passage and due

Shuodek

Monique Scot”
Alderwoman, 24th Ward
